meta.name: alfworld-object-state-modifier
meta.description: Uses an appliance to change the state of an object (cooling, heating, or cleaning). Use when the task requires altering an object's temperature or cleanliness using a specific device (e.g., cooling with a fridge, heating with a microwave, cleaning with a sinkbasin). Takes the object, target state, and appliance as inputs and executes the corresponding modifier action.

copy.tagline: 用设备改变物体的温度或清洁状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模拟环境中用电器改变物体状态
copy.tagline_en: Change an object's temperature or cleanliness using an appliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to modify object states using appliances in a simulated environment

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用冰箱、微波炉、水槽等电器来冷却、加热或清洁物体。执行前需先手持目标物体，然后导航到电器并操作。
howto.when: 当任务需要改变物体温度（冷却/加热）或清洁度时，例如用户要求“把这个苹果冷却一下”。

say.text: 把我的番茄放进冰箱冷却。
say.note: Claude 会前往冰箱并执行冷却。

say.text: 用微波炉热一下这个杯子。
say.note: Claude 会前往微波炉并加热。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use household appliances (e.g., fridge, microwave, sinkbasin) to cool, heat, or clean objects. The user must hold the object first, then navigate to the appliance and execute the action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task requires altering an object's temperature (cool/heat) or cleanliness, e.g., when the user asks to cool a tomato or heat a cup.

say_en.text: Cool my tomato in the fridge.
say_en.note: Claude will go to the fridge and cool the tomato.

say_en.text: Heat this cup in the microwave.
say_en.note: Claude will go to the microwave and heat the cup.
